snippet.title: Funeral for the Sun - Official Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the latest trailer for Funeral for the Sun, a detective mystery game developed by Nicolás Cid Delgado. Rooted in Latin American history and magical realism, Funeral for the Sun blends narrative investigation with themes of memory, folklore, and colonial resistance. Funeral for the Sun is coming soon to PC (Steam).
